summary: Vendor payment blocked: Atlas Cloudworks EUR invoice (INV-2026-311) - PO mismatch and FX variance
description:
Issue summary:
Vendor 'Atlas Cloudworks' invoice INV-2026-311 (EUR 48,360.00) is blocked in the payments ledger due to a PO mapping mismatch and a currency variance flag. The AP workflow put the payment on hold automatically for manual review.

Impact:
- Payment to vendor pending; vendor has emailed requesting payment status.
- Potential service disruption for onboarding infra licenses if not cleared before 2026-03-17.
- This is an internal finance hold (no customer impact) but time-sensitive for vendor SLAs.

Invoice / PO details:
- Invoice ID: INV-2026-311 (attached PDF)
- Vendor: Atlas Cloudworks (Vendor ID: V-1182)
- Invoice currency / amount: EUR 48,360.00
- Submitted PO referenced on invoice: PO-EN-3112
- Our system matched to PO: PO-EN-3121 (different line items / different currency code set to EUR in PO but cost center mismatch)
- FX variance flagged: system detected realized exchange-rate delta > 2% vs AP tolerance, auto-hold set.

Environment / systems: prod payments ledger (NetPay-v3 connector), Purchasing service, FX reconciliation job (fx-recon-us). Region: eu-west.

Steps to reproduce / reproduce path:
1) Download invoice INV-2026-311 from vendor portal (attachment).
2) In Payments Console search by Invoice ID -> shows status: ON_HOLD (reason: PO_MISMATCH; FX_VARIANCE).
3) Payment attempt shows ledger entry rejected by netpay connector with error code NETPAY:PO_MAP_CONFLICT at 2026-03-10T09:12:34Z.
4) Manual cross-check shows invoice references PO-EN-3112, but purchasing index maps the PO to a legacy supplier code that differs from vendor V-1182.

Investigation notes (so far):
- 2026-03-10: AP analyst (L. Moreno) reviewed attachments and confirmed PO number on invoice does not match our canonical PO in the purchasing system.
- 2026-03-10: Payments ledger logged NETPAY:FX_DELTA_EXCEEDED when attempting to create the payment batch (fx rate delta = 2.8%). AP tolerance is 2.0%.
- 2026-03-11: Purchasing flagged that PO-EN-3112 was reissued last quarter and a new PO-EN-3121 was created during supplier consolidation; vendor may have used the old PO.
- Cross-team hypothesis: vendor submitted old PO; NetPay rejects because cost-center/GL mapping differs and fx-recon job flagged variance.

Immediate impact mitigation tried:
- Manual override of FX tolerance attempted by FinanceOps but blocked by policy.
- Contacted vendor (email thread linked in comments) requesting reissued invoice referencing PO-EN-3121 or confirmation to remap PO on our side.
- Raised temporary hold exception request to Treasury for payments > EUR25k; awaiting sign-off.

Attachments / logs: invoice-INV-2026-311.pdf, screenshot-ledger-2026-03-10.png, payments-log-2026-03-10.txt (NetPay error block excerpt).

Next steps / ask from Purchasing and FinanceOps:
- Purchasing: confirm canonical PO for this vendor and whether PO-EN-3112 should be mapped to V-1182 or marked legacy. If vendor used legacy PO, please advise if we should allow remapping.
- Vendor liaison: request vendor to reissue invoice referencing PO-EN-3121 or provide written confirmation to accept mapping to PO-EN-3121.
- Treasury/Finance leadership: approve one-time manual FX tolerance override or exception to allow payment to proceed while reconciliation completes.
- Engineering (Payments): provide a short-term temporary workflow to allow manual PO remapping for this invoice ID while maintaining audit trail.

Preferred resolution target: 2026-03-15 to avoid SLA breach with vendor.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Laura Moreno (AP): I validated the invoice PDF and PO on the vendor copy is PO-EN-3112. Our purchasing index lists PO-EN-3112 as closed and associated historically with legacy vendor V-1079. Vendor ID mismatch triggers our PO_MISMATCH rule.

2026-03-11 - Arjun Singh (Purchasing): Confirmed PO-EN-3112 was superseded by PO-EN-3121 during supplier consolidation on 2025-11-02. I can update vendor mapping but need written confirmation from vendor to change the PO owner in the purchasing system.

2026-03-11 - Maya Patel (FinanceOps): Ran FX recon job — realized exchange delta is 2.8%, over tolerance. Treasury must approve any FX tolerance override. Raised request to treasury-approvals@redwood; awaiting response.

2026-03-12 - Ethan Kim (Payments Eng): Logged a request with Payments team to expose a manual PO remap endpoint for single invoice workflow. Will provide ETA for a safe, auditable remap path by 2026-03-13 EOD.
2026-03-12 - Treasury (auto-reply): Received approval request #TR-2026-089. Approvers: K. Flores, R. Allen. Expect response within 24 hours.
